summary: Iteration 58 intelligent routing tested end-to-end (backend pytest + frontend Playwright). All 6 backend tests PASS. Frontend modal field 'agent-config-field-routing' visible with saved value, dirty indicator + Save button work. Routing correctly directs sales intent to Isabella and support intent to Bruno Suporte; conversation consistency maintained (2nd inbound on sales phone stayed with Isabella via routed_agent_id). LLM was called (gpt-5-mini and gemini-2.5-flash) — gemini returned empty reply for support but agent selection was still correct (this is an existing LLM provider issue, not a routing bug).

minor.issue: Bruno Suporte's gemini-2.5-flash model occasionally returns empty reply (delivery_status=failed_empty_reply). Routing decision is still correct (agent_name=Bruno Suporte persisted), so this does not affect the intelligent-routing feature, but reply text was empty.

action_items: Optional: investigate gemini-2.5-flash empty-reply on simple Portuguese support prompts (separate issue, not blocking routing feature).
critical_code_review_comments: services/routing.py: clean, well-commented (3-tier strategy: keyword → LLM → fallback). Persists routed_agent_id on wa_conversations for consistency — verified working in test_05.
services/routing.py uses __import__('core').now_iso() inside _persist_routing — works but a top-level import would be cleaner.
Behavior verified: with only 1 active agent, routing returns it directly (no LLM call) preserving old behavior.
AgentConfigModal: routing_intent textarea has explanatory hint with concrete examples — good UX.
seed_data_creation: Created two test conversations (5511955550101 — Cliente V — routed to Isabella; 5511955550102 — Cliente S — routed to Bruno Suporte). Bruno Suporte agent created and deleted by fixture teardown. Conversations remain in DB with routed_agent_id (acceptable — auto-reply turned OFF at the end so no future replies).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routing feature lives in /app/backend/services/routing.py and is invoked from whatsapp_baileys._maybe_auto_reply. routing_intent field is on aihub_agents (PATCH/POST supported). Frontend field testid: agent-config-field-routing inside section agent-config-section-autoreply. Auto-reply state was disabled at end of test (enabled:false). Isabella keeps routing_intent='vendas, novos planos, contratação, preço'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial 3 test failures during first run were due to test code using direction=='out' and 'timestamp' field, while API returns direction='outbound' and 'wa_timestamp'/'created_at'. Fixed in test script — all tests pass on retry.
